requiredFindings.title: PLAN-r3 incorrectly claims static-profile/context timing agreement within about 1%
requiredFindings.evidence: Independent comparison of the accepted nine static-profile and context medians gives differences relative to context of +0.412%, -0.444%, +3.597%, +0.898%, +7.774%, -0.507%, +1.961%, +0.751%, +0.687%. The quoted Axum pair alone is 4061.596 ms versus3920.591 ms, a3.597% difference, not about1%.
requiredFindings.impact: The proposed D-5 delta relies on an inaccurate empirical agreement claim. Matching eligible populations and similar timing order do not establish the claimed numerical tolerance or statistical equivalence.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Correct or remove the within-about-1% assertion in PLAN-r3 and its authoring script. If retaining a quantitative comparison, cite the accepted series, state the comparison denominator and actual range or per-row differences, and label it descriptive. Retain the independent static-command-data/boundary rationale, exact variant/measurement evidence and the other PLAN-r2 definitions. No rerun is needed.
